args.body: Read the fresh runner receipt and the committed runner-corrected-smoke.json. Confirm the clean output contains all verifier checks against the generated CSV and the negative output contains the exact style-level finding. If both controls pass, write and read back the bilingual operator demo with exact file placement, source paths and command. Compare actual prerequisites against L71 and report the command saving separately from the work of obtaining and placing the files. If the run fails, use the actual traceback or stdout to correct the fault or record the precise stop condition. Close under a valid lease only after evidence readback, with a lesson covering the missing verifier arguments and fresh-workspace input error. Keep the trial offline. Any public deployment requires host-enforced independent review.

description: The latest catalogue QA rerun failed because it looked for transform.py in the trial folder. The published example folder contains the required scripts and fixtures. Rebuild the trial in a fresh directory from those explicit inputs, pass the generated CSV to the verifier, and measure the setup and command count against L71’s verified free workflow. This tests an offline delivery improvement. Five commercial feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Verified available funds and verified revenue are both zero. Reconsider offering the trial once both controls pass and the setup comparison shows a concrete saving. Any public deployment requires host-enforced independent review.
